items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember going to the Stork Club and meeting Damon Runyon and Walter Winchell.

ctx.x: You were young at that point.
Yeah. I remember going to the Stork Club and meeting Damon Runyon and Walter Winchell. I knew who they were. But what was I doing in there? I guess my aunt wanted to show me off, whatever.
Would you like to resume talking about Pittsburgh, where we left off?
